title: Integrating Verified Resource Evidence into Reasoning & Multi-Stream Context
research_question: Can external software resource evidence be formatted, bounded, and injected into the agent reasoning context with unambiguous truth boundaries so that Gemma 4 distinguishes internal code facts, positive experiences, negative failure anti-priors, and external advisory documentation without treating unverified resources as ground truth?
components_implemented: lifecore_swe.resources.context_builder.ResourceContextBuilder (Structured external evidence block, status warnings, provenance citations, budget truncation)
lifecore_swe.resources.context_builder.UnifiedWorldModelContextBuilder (4-stream evidence synthesis with explicit trust boundaries)
lifecore_swe.agent.agent.SWEAgent (Integration of enable_resource_graph, resource pre-retrieval, state observation injection, reasoning context injection)
evidence_streams_supported: STREAM 1: INTERNAL CODE EVIDENCE (AST REPOSITORY GRAPH)
STREAM 4: EXTERNAL RESOURCE EVIDENCE (PROVENANCE & VERSION AWARE)
truth_boundary_rules_enforced: INTERNAL REPOSITORY CODE IS ABSOLUTE GROUND TRUTH
VERIFIED POSITIVE EXPERIENCE PROVIDES PROVEN STRUCTURAL PRIORS
NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE WARNS AGAINST KNOWN FAILED TRANSITIONS
EXTERNAL RESOURCES ARE ADVISORY ONLY (NEVER TREAT UNVERIFIED SPECS AS GROUND TRUTH)
security_boundary_isolation: VERIFIED (Zero mutation of GraphIndex, ExperienceGraphOverlay, or NegativeGraphOverlay)
